data.long_meaning: The name Bazarun is derived from the Arabic word 'buzr' meaning ripe, and the suffix 'an' which denotes a fruit or a thing. This name signifies a ripe and abundant fruit, symbolizing prosperity and abundance in one's life. The name Bazarun carries the meaning “Ripe fruit” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Bazarun usually hope their child will grow to embody ripe fruit and live with faith, good character and purpose.
